pinned_at_state: no W5 artefact had been authored. Every file under the watched directories was byte-identical to its counterpart on a previous board — a starting point, not authorship.
what_this_proves: the bytes, and the seed state. The digests survive a checkout, a copy and a commit; the mtime does not, and is recorded because it is the only ordering witness that will not.
what_this_does_not_prove: that the author intended this before drawing. Only that these bytes preceded every authored artefact. A later change to the pinned file is a lock failure, not a silent edit.
governs: every declaration the W5 gates check against
